plan: Use a current non-sensitive reproducer to determine whether OCR produces no text, incorrect text, or correct text that is not copied.
Trace only the corresponding OCR-selection or clipboard-transfer path after the failure mode is established.
Correct the identified path and add a focused regression case for the source/content type that fails.

confidence.rationale: A partial failure is reported, but the source and actual clipboard result are missing, leaving materially different causes possible.

inferences: The failure may be OCR recognition, selection/source-surface behavior, or clipboard transfer; current evidence does not distinguish them.

issue_context.analysis: Avoid another generic diagnostic request. One minimal current-version example identifying the source surface and expected versus actual clipboard result will show whether OCR or clipboard transfer is implicated.

comment.body: Thanks for confirming that Text Extractor copied most of the page but failed on one particular area, and for sharing an image. The report names PowerToys 0.87.1 and COMODO, but not the source surface or what ended up on the clipboard, so we cannot distinguish an OCR recognition failure from a clipboard-transfer failure. Could you repeat once on the latest stable PowerToys and reply with the source app/content type, short steps, and a redacted expected-versus-actual text example? Please omit sensitive text; no new image is needed.
